metadata.question: Did the Indus Basin aquifer region centered at coordinates 31.998723, 73.931617 (within a 10km radius) experience significant groundwater decline between 2003 and 2013?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use GRACE land water-equivalent thickness anomalies dataset (NASA/GRACE/MASS_GRIDS/LAND) for 2003-2013, compute area-mean within 10 km radius around 31.998723, 73.931617.
2. Masking strategy: No cloud masking needed (GRACE mascon). Use reduction over AOI with large scale to align with coarse resolution.
3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: Check collection size; compute per-image valid pixel counts; if all counts are 0 -> C2. If slope NaN/invalid -> C3. Otherwise decide A/B based on negative slope magnitude.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); // You must include this line

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const center = ee.Geometry.Point([73.931617, 31.998723]);
    const aoi = center.buffer(10000); // 10 km
    const start = '2003-01-01';
    const end = '2013-12-31';

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check
    let col = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/GRACE/MASS_GRIDS/LAND')
      .filterDate(start, end)
      .select(['lwe_thickness']);
    const nImages = col.size();
    const nImg = nImages.getInfo();
    if (!nImg || nImg === 0) {
      console.log(`Images 2003-2013: 0`);
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }

    // Add per-image mean and count within AOI
    const scale = 100000; // GRACE mascon coarse scale
    const withStats = col.map(function(img) {
      const count = img.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: aoi,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get('lwe_thickness');
      const mean = img.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry: aoi,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get('lwe_thickness');
      return img.set({count: count, mean: mean});
    });

    // Pull arrays client-side
    const means = withStats.aggregate_array('mean').getInfo();
    const counts = withStats.aggregate_array('count').getInfo();
    const times = withStats.aggregate_array('system:time_start').getInfo();

    // Filter valid records
    let X = [];
    let Y = [];
    let validPixelCounts = [];
    let validImages = 0;
    let totalPixelCount = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < means.length; i++) {
      const m = means[i];
      const c = counts[i] || 0;
      const t = times[i];
      if (m !== null && m !== undefined && isFinite(m) && c > 0) {
        X.push(t);
        Y.push(m); // cm of water eq.
        validPixelCounts.push(c);
        validImages += 1;
        totalPixelCount += c;
      }
    }

    console.log(`Images 2003-2013: ${nImg}, Valid images: ${validImages}`);

    if (validImages === 0) {
      console.log('No valid pixels after reduction.');
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    // Convert times to years relative to mid-time
    const msPerYear = 1000 * 60 * 60 * 24 * 365.25;
    const t0 = 0.5 * (Math.min(...X) + Math.max(...X));
    const xYears = X.map(v => (v - t0) / msPerYear);

    // Compute linear regression statistics
    function stats(x, y) {
      const n = x.length;
      const mx = x.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/n;
      const my = y.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/n;
      let sxx = 0, syy = 0, sxy = 0;
      for (let i=0;i<n;i++){
        const dx = x[i]-mx;
        const dy = y[i]-my;
        sxx += dx*dx;
        syy += dy*dy;
        sxy += dx*dy;
      }
      const slope = sxy / sxx; // cm per year
      const intercept = my - slope*mx;
      const r = sxy / Math.sqrt(sxx*syy);
      return {n, slope, intercept, r};
    }

    const st = stats(xYears, Y);
    if (!isFinite(st.slope) || isNaN(st.slope)) {
      console.log('Invalid slope calculation.');
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    // Early vs Late means as corroboration
    const earlyEnd = Date.parse('2005-12-31');
    const lateStart = Date.parse('2011-01-01');
    let earlyVals = [], lateVals = [];
    for (let i=0;i<X.length;i++){
      if (X[i] <= earlyEnd) earlyVals.push(Y[i]);
      if (X[i] >= lateStart) lateVals.push(Y[i]);
    }
    const meanArr = arr => arr.length ? arr.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/arr.length : null;
    const earlyMean = meanArr(earlyVals);
    const lateMean = meanArr(lateVals);
    const diff = (earlyMean !== null && lateMean !== null) ? (lateMean - earlyMean) : null;

    // Print concise evidence
    const avgPx = (totalPixelCount/validImages).toFixed(1);
    console.log(`Avg valid pixels/image: ${avgPx}`);
    console.log(`Slope (cm/yr): ${st.slope.toFixed(2)}`);
    console.log(`r^2: ${(st.r*st.r).toFixed(2)}`);
    console.log(`Early(2003-2005) mean cm: ${earlyMean !== null ? earlyMean.toFixed(2) : 'NA'}`);
    console.log(`Late(2011-2013) mean cm: ${lateMean !== null ? lateMean.toFixed(2) : 'NA'}`);
    console.log(`Late - Early (cm): ${diff !== null ? diff.toFixed(2) : 'NA'}`);

    // 5. Decision rule: significant decline if slope < -0.5 cm/yr and r^2 >= 0.2
    const significant = (st.slope < -0.5) && ((st.r*st.r) >= 0.2);
    console.log(significant ? 'A' : 'B');
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${err && err.message ? err.message : err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
